Hebrew display · MT / WLCLiteral draft
01HYB.PS.001.001
אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב׃

Happy is the person who has not walked by the counsel of the wicked, stood in the way of sinners, or sat in the seat of scoffers.

02HYB.PS.001.002
כִּ֤י אִ֥ם בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃

Instead, his delight is in YHWH’s instruction, and he recites that instruction by day and by night.

03HYB.PS.001.003
וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל־פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ ׀ יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃

He is like a tree planted beside channels of water, yielding its fruit in its season, its leaf not withering. Everything he does prospers.

04HYB.PS.001.004
לֹא־כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲֽשֶׁר־תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ׃

Not so the wicked: they are like chaff that the wind drives away.

05HYB.PS.001.005
עַל־כֵּ֤ן ׀ לֹא־יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים׃

Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

06HYB.PS.001.006
כִּֽי־יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃

For YHWH knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked perishes.

EDITORIAL NOTES

Text and translation notes

  1. Torah can denote instruction or law. This draft uses ‘instruction’ without fixing the precise scope of the writings intended.
  2. The verb hagah can connect reflection with murmured recitation. ‘Recites’ is a contextual choice, not a claim that the verb has only one meaning.
  3. In verse 6 the subject that perishes is ‘the way of the wicked’. Verse 3 is not expanded into a guarantee of material success in every circumstance. This is an interpretive note.

Selected vocabulary

These are selected draft glosses, not a complete word-aligned interlinear translation.
